semiconductor_relevance: High — YSystems specializes in automated optical metrology instruments crucial for semiconductor wafer inspection and measurement.
summary: YSystems Ltd. designs and manufactures advanced optical metrology instruments, focusing on non-contact optical property mapping systems for semiconductor wafers. Their products include the YWafer Inspector for defect detection on SiC and GaN wafers and the YChip Bonder for various bonding applications.
capabilities: YWafer Inspector for surface defects and impurity detection
YChip Bonder for solder and epoxy bonding

regional_presence.Japan: YSystems is established in Tokushima, rural Japan, focusing on the semiconductor industry.
